title: Shadows over Innistrad block/Preconstructed theme decks
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Shadows over Innistrad block intro packs)

paragraphs.text: The Shadows over Innistrad block is composed of the large expansion Shadows over Innistrad ( ) and the small expansion Eldritch Moon ( ). As the second block under the Two-Block Paradigm , it was released over the course of 2016.
Mechanics introduced in this block include Delirium , Investigate , Skulk , Emerge , Meld , and Escalate .
The Shadows over Innistrad block has ten bi-colored preconstructed theme decks .
